# Keep going to the previous song until we reach a liked song.
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
steps = 0
while current["song_id"] not in liked_ids:
    apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    steps += 1
    if steps > 100:
        raise RuntimeError("Exceeded 100 previous song attempts without finding a liked song.")
print("Reached liked song after", steps, "previous song(s):", current)
